- Outbound delivery executes in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, function `Post` (line 120). The actual HTTP request is `safeClient.Do(req)` at line 152. Content-change handlers enqueue via `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 70–71); worker goroutines consume the queue and call `Post` (lines 42–53).
- SSRF protection is enforced at dial time by `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:57–76`), configured as the HTTP transport’s `DialContext` (`:29–36`). It resolves the hostname and rejects IPs where `isReservedIP` is true.
- The blocked ranges are defined in `internal/webhook/validate.go:11–23` (loopback, RFC-1918 private, link-local/IMDS, and IPv6 local/link-local ranges). URLs are also checked on create/update via `ValidateURL` in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:71–75` and `:159–163`.
- Caveat: `allow-private-webhooks` sets `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` in `cmd/memos/main.go:49`, disabling this protection when explicitly enabled.
